subject: Fintegrate MAP draft — gating checklist and data retention clarifications
messages:
From: Amanda Chen <amanda.chen@fintegrate.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2028-08-27T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Fintegrate MAP draft + initial gating questions

Hi Aditya / Laura,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited about Redwood as a candidate for our inference layer. Attached is our first-pass MAP (Fintegrate_MAP_v1.xlsx) and a CAIQ we started populating. Before we lock timelines with procurement, we need alignment on a handful of gating items so our security team can sign off: 

- SOC 2: do you have a recent SOC 2 Type II report? If not, what equivalent artifacts can you share (control descriptions, testing evidence, PIIscope notes)?
- CAIQ/SIG: we marked a few higher-risk controls as TBD in the spreadsheet. Can you confirm which items you can complete with screenshots/config in the next 7 business days?
- DPA & retention: Fintegrate's policy requires a default retention of 90 days for persistent customer data unless a longer window is negotiated. Are you flexible on a 90/365 retention tier and can you support an EU-data residency clause?
- Evidence access: we will need an evidence intake plan (who provides what, delivery format, expected dates).

Target close for commercial exec approval: 2028-09-15. Is that realistic from your side if gating items are cleared?

Appended: a short redline on the DPA (high level).

Attachments: Fintegrate_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP), caiaq-questions.csv (our initial notes)

Would appreciate a concise owner-level response with concrete dates — happy to jump on a 30m call if useful.

Best,
Amanda Chen
Director, Strategic Partnerships
Fintegrate
security@fintegrate.com

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Amanda Chen <amanda.chen@fintegrate.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-08-27T17:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fintegrate MAP draft + initial gating questions

Amanda — thanks for the MAP and the CAIQ export. We're aligned on the proposed close window and can move quickly if we scope the acceptance criteria clearly. High-level answers below and an ask for a short intake tracker: 

On SOC 2:
- Redwood has a current SOC 2 Type II (covering security & availability) and we can share the report under NDA.
- If you need control testing artifacts, we can provide control narratives, sample evidence (audit logs, change control tickets) and a short mapping doc by EOD 2028-08-31.

On CAIQ/SIG:
- We'll fill the CAIQ items marked TBD and provide screenshot evidence for controls around network segmentation, key management, and change control. ETA: 2028-08-31 for initial pass; final pass by 2028-09-05.

On DPA & retention:
- Default option: 90 days for customer persistent data (configurable).
- Optional tiers: 30d (ephemeral mode), 90d (default), 365d (archival) — we can list tradeoffs for cost and export.
- EU data residency: supported via our Private deployment (we'll include required contract language).

Evidence access / intake plan (proposed):
- 2028-08-29: Redwood to upload SOC2 redacted report + SOC2 mapping doc to a secure share (link below).
- 2028-08-31: CAIQ first-pass with screenshots (attachment: caiaq-answers-draft.csv).
- 2028-09-05: Final CAIQ + any follow-up artifacts.

Would you prefer these delivered to an S3 share or directly to your security mailbox? Also can you confirm the procurement target approval on 2028-09-15 so we can prioritize resources?

Attachments: redwood_soc2-evidence-checklist.pdf, caiaq-answers-draft.csv, Fintegrate_MAP_v1.xlsx (annotated)

Cheers,
Aditya Rao
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Amanda Chen <amanda.chen@fintegrate.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-08-28T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fintegrate MAP draft + initial gating questions

Amanda — adding a technical view on the evidence packages and a couple of implementation clarifications: 

What we can deliver quickly:
- Redacted SOC 2 Type II report (PDF) + control mapping (matrix mapping SOC categories to Fintegrate CAIQ items).
- Audit log samples: syslog export for a named test tenant (timestamped, redacted PII).
- Architecture diagram showing tenancy model, network zones, and KMS/HSM placement.
- Screenshots: IAM console roles, key rotation policy, VPC peering config (where relevant).

Retention specifics:
- Ephemeral processing cache: default 24–72 hours, not retained beyond anonymized metrics.
- Persistent customer objects: configurable per-customer — we propose three standard windows: 30 / 90 / 365 days. Default is 90d unless contract specifies otherwise.
- Audit logs & forensic exports: we retain full audit logs for 365 days; longer-term archival is available as a paid add-on.

DPA redline notes:
- We can accept most standard DPA language; two exceptions require legal review: (1) forward-transfer restrictions for sub-processors in specific jurisdictions, and (2) key-escrow/KMS control language. If Fintegrate requires HSM custody or an escrow model, we need to scope that as a separate SOW.

Evidence delivery formats: PDF for reports, CSV for CSVable CAIQ answers, and a temporary secure share (S3 or a signed Drive link).

I'll prepare a one-page evidence-runbook and upload to the HubSpot deal (link below) by 2028-08-29 midday.

Thanks — Laura
Laura Bennett
Principal Security Engagement Manager
Redwood Inference
